title: 第151章 大生意第150章 以你为准
lines: 第151章大生意
米丽一把揪上小火，一溜小跑跟进帐蓬。
有东西的那头，不可能集中在一起，肯定这一个地方那一个地方分散的到处都是，接东西的这一头，也不能一股脑儿的全堆一起，堆一起又是个麻烦，哪个东西从哪儿放哪儿，不能错了。
还有，最好事先安排清爽，别太烦琐，别重复，别搬完了又说不对，那位卫老板这会儿心情好，谁知道他过会儿心情怎么样？要是这个那个太烦了，他发了脾气，那就太可怕了。
这一条周局和米丽意见一致。
周局把九局的人都叫了回来，赶紧整理从哪儿到哪儿的清单，整理出一份，仔细对过，交给米丽，米丽提着心交给卫桓。
好在卫桓这心情相当好，当然他神通更好，拿着头一张单子，对着眼前一片虚空比划了片刻，突然看着米丽问道：“人都清空了？”
米丽一个怔神，“还没吧，先给您看看。”
“我看这干什么？把人清空再给我。”卫桓将单子扔给米丽，米丽抱住单子，狂跑进帐蓬，这一回，将近半个小时才跑出来，“好了。”
卫桓再次接过，皱眉看了看，噢了一声，将单子掉个个儿，片刻，将单子扔给米丽，“好了，先别给他们，叫小火去对一遍，老子头一回干这样的活，这一堆玩意儿长的差不多，分好几个地方，要是错了，老子丢不起这脸。”
米丽赶紧将单子塞给紧跟在她后面的小火，小火跑的飞快，去对东西。
整个九局忙的人仰马翻，一个个敲键盘敲的手指抖，打电话打的嗓子哑。
米丽和小火来回跑着核对，累的腿软，卫桓半个小时一个小时接张单子，一两分钟就把单子扔出去了，闲的呵欠连天。
曲灵跟着盛夏，找了半天，也没找到邓风来，倒是遇到了老曹。
老曹一头一身全是土，在龙头镇边上一个土坑里窝着，正一只手拎着一包甜瓜，一只手抓着一只啃，要不是听到了咔哧呼噜的啃瓜声，盛夏和曲灵根本没看到他，他跟周围简直就是一体。
“老曹。”盛夏蹲在坑边上，捡块小石头砸在老曹身上。
老曹被盛夏这一声老曹吓了一跳，一口瓜噎着，脖子伸了好几伸才咽下去，“是你，老米呢？小常呢？你怎么一个人出来晃荡？这儿不安全，刚才那边又塌了。”
“老米忙着，老常找乌龟和八哥去了，你吃瓜能吃饱？”盛夏伸头看了看老曹那一袋瓜。
“顶一顶吧，比没有强。邓风来那货的仓库塌了，就一堆瓜还好好儿的，只能吃瓜，我家里有吃的，出来的急，忘带了，就是不忘，也带不了多少，咯！”老曹一边说一边吃，噎着了。
“那个卫桓，你知道……”
老曹听盛夏说到卫桓两个字，眼睛一下子瞪大，这一下噎的厉害了，一声连一声的打嗝。
盛夏不说了，看着老曹，等他嗝的差不多了，才接着道：“卫桓正帮九局搬设备呢，好象搬的挺快，一会儿等设备上来了，你跟邓风来就不用太用力了。除了你还有谁来了？”
老曹有点儿傻，“帮九局？搬……真是神通广大，他就不怕……搬都搬了，肯定不怕，咱们的，能来的都来了，算了，反正你都知道，也都知道你，在滨海的，都来了。老妙怎么样了？那个马国伟说，老妙被带走养伤了？”
盛夏嗯了一声，“马国伟和黄云生呢？也来了？”
“那不知道，没看到他俩，他俩是卫老板的人，跟咱们不一样，不是咱们这边的，吃个瓜。”老曹这才想起来让盛夏和曲灵吃瓜。
“你那瓜多脏呢，不吃。”曲灵一脸嫌弃，盛夏也没接，那瓜是脏。早几百年，老曹开的那小饭铺，也跟这瓜差不多干净，她在他饭铺里，连碗水都不喝，这一百来年，总算干净了，这会儿，这脏的，好象一下子又回到几百年前了。
“老米忙什么呢？听说这小妮子入道了？邓风来说的。”老曹心事忡忡，不过这也不耽误他好奇八卦。
“老米看着卫桓搬东西呢……”
“看着卫……”老曹再次打起了噎嗝，一边打嗝，一边指着盛夏，猛的一个大嗝之后，说出话了，“邓风来说，那个卫老板，迷上你了？小夏我跟你说，这事靠不住，男人……不是，雄性，哪有能靠得住的？都不是好东西，邓风来也这么说，老米，还有老妙……这事儿是不是有因哪？”
“嗯，有因，没事儿，你别担心。对了，还有件事，协会走了，协会那摊子事儿，交给卫桓了。”盛夏一边说一边站起来。
“什么？”老曹一下子从坑底窜起来，“这话怎么说？走了？啥意思？”
“就是，卫桓说，以后这人界的非人，归他管，这是原话。”盛夏边往后退了好几步，避开老曹猛然窜起带出来尘土。“你去找邓风来，还有别的谁谁，说一声这事，以后有什么事儿找老米，跟邓风来说一声，一会儿设备到了，让他别再出傻劲了，我还有点儿事儿，忙过这场事儿，都到我家聚聚吧，有什么话到时候再说。”
盛夏交待完，冲呆站在坑里的老曹挥了下手，和曲灵往九局帐蓬那边过去，周凯他们该到了吧，卡维家那些钱的事，得跟周凯商量商量，就算不能全拿回来，也得尽可能多的拿回来。
回到九局那顶帐蓬门口，周凯宋词，和孙瀚两个刚刚赶到，周凯累的既不讲究干不干净，也不讲究他的风度了，一屁股坐在地上，张着嘴喘粗气。

Chapter 151 Big Business
Millie grabbed Xiao Huo and trotted to follow the tent.
It is impossible to gather things together at the end where there are things. They must be scattered here and there. At the end where things are received, they cannot be piled up together. Stacking them together will be troublesome. There must be no mistake about where to put things.
Also, it’s best to arrange the cleaning in advance, don’t be too cumbersome, don’t repeat it, don’t say it’s wrong after the move is done, that boss Wei is in a good mood now, who knows how he will be in the future? If this or that gets too annoying and he loses his temper, that would be terrible.
Zhou Ju and Mi Li agreed on this point.
Bureau Zhou called all the people from the Ninth Bureau back and quickly sorted out the list of where to go, compiled a list, checked it carefully, and handed it to Mi Li, who handed it to Wei Huan with her heart in mind.
Fortunately, Wei Huan was in a good mood. Of course, he had better magical powers. He took the first list and gestured to the void in front of him for a moment. Then he suddenly looked at Mi Li and asked, "Everyone has been emptied?"
Millie was startled, "Not yet, I'll show you first."
"What do I think this is for? Empty the people and give them to me." Wei Huan threw the list to Mi Li, who hugged the list and ran into the tent. This time, it took nearly half an hour to run out, "Okay."
Wei Huan took it again, frowned and looked at it. He said oh, dropped the list, and after a moment, threw the list to Mi Li, "Okay, don't give it to them yet, ask Xiaohuo to check it again. This is my first time doing such a job. These piles of things are similar in length and divided into several places. If I make a mistake, I can't afford to lose face."
Mi Li quickly handed the list to Xiao Huo who was following her closely. Xiao Huo ran very fast to get the right thing.
The entire ninth bureau was full of busy people, their fingers trembled when typing on the keyboard, and their voices became hoarse while typing on the phone.
Mi Li and Xiao Huo ran back and forth to check, their legs weak from exhaustion. Wei Huan took orders every half an hour and threw them out in a minute or two, yawning endlessly.
Qu Ling followed Sheng Xia and searched for a long time, but could not find Deng Fenglai. Instead, he met Lao Cao.
Lao Cao, who was covered in dirt all over his head and body, was nesting in a pit on the edge of Longtou Town. He was holding a pack of melons in one hand and gnawing one with the other. If they hadn't heard the sound of gnawing melons, Shengxia and Qu Ling wouldn't have seen him at all. He was just one with the surroundings.
"Old Cao." Shengxia squatted beside the pit, picked up a small stone and threw it at Lao Cao.
Lao Cao was startled by Sheng Xia's voice. He choked on a mouthful of melon and stretched his neck several times before swallowing. "It's you. Where's Lao Mi? Where's Xiao Chang? Why are you hanging out alone? It's not safe here. It collapsed again just now."
"Lao Mi is busy. Lao Chang is looking for turtles and starlings. Can you be full with melons?" Shengxia stretched her head and looked at Lao Cao's bag of melons.
"Just give me one, it's better than nothing. The warehouse where Deng Feng came to sell melons collapsed, so it's just a bunch of melons. I can only eat melons. I have food at home, but I forgot to bring it when I came out. Even if I don't forget it, I won't be able to bring much with me, haha!" Lao Cao choked while eating.
"That Wei Huan, you know..."
When Lao Cao heard Sheng Xia mention the word "Wei Huan", his eyes widened suddenly. He choked violently and hiccupped repeatedly.
Shengxia stopped talking and looked at Lao Cao. After he almost hiccupped, he continued: "Wei Huan is helping the Ninth Bureau move the equipment. It seems to be moving very fast. When the equipment comes up in a while, you and Deng Feng will not have to use too much force. Who else is coming besides you?"
Lao Cao was a bit stupid, "Help the Ninth Bureau? Move... He is so powerful, he is not afraid... He has moved everything, so he is definitely not afraid. We have all the ones who can come. Forget it, you all know it anyway, and everyone in Binhai is here. How is Lao Miao? That Ma Guowei said that Lao Miao was taken away to recuperate?"
Shengxia hummed, "Where are Ma Guowei and Huang Yunsheng? Are they here too?"
"I don't know. I haven't seen them. They are boss Wei's people. They are different from us. They are not from our side. Let's have fun." Only then did Lao Cao remember to let Shengxia and Qu Ling have fun.
"Your melon is so dirty. I won't eat it." Qu Ling looked disgusted and didn't pick it up in Shengxia. That melon was dirty. A few hundred years ago, the small restaurant opened by Lao Cao was almost as clean as this melon. She didn't even drink a bowl of water in his restaurant. Over the past hundred years, it was finally clean. Now, this dirty place seemed to have returned to hundreds of years ago.
"What are Lao Mi busy with? I heard that this little girl has become a Taoist? Deng Feng told me." Lao Cao was worried, but this did not stop him from being curious about gossip.
"Lao Mi is watching Wei Huan move things..."
"Look at Wei..." Lao Cao burped again. While burping, he pointed at Shengxia. After a big burp, he spoke, "Deng Feng, is that Boss Wei obsessed with you? Xiaoxia, let me tell you, this matter is unreliable. Men... no, males, how can anyone be reliable? They are not good things. Deng Fenglai also said the same, Lao Mi, and Lao Miao... Is there a reason for this?"
"Well, there is a reason. It's okay. Don't worry. By the way, there is one more thing. The association has left, and the association's affairs will be left to Wei Huan." Shengxia said while standing up.
"What?" Lao Cao suddenly jumped up from the bottom of the pit, "How do you say this? Leave? What do you mean?"
"That's right, Wei Huan said that from now on, the non-human beings in the human world will be under his control. These are his exact words." Sheng Xia took a few steps back to avoid the dust that Lao Cao suddenly jumped up and brought out. "You come to Deng Feng, and anyone else, and tell me about this. If you have anything to do in the future, talk to Lao Mi and tell Deng Feng. The equipment will arrive soon, and tell him to stop being stupid. I still have something to do. After this, please come to my house to get together. If you have anything to say, we can talk about it then."
After Sheng Xia finished explaining, he waved at Lao Cao, who was standing in the pit.
